title: I Reported the Hallway Stroller With the Serial on the No-Storage Sign

parts.text: I photographed the stroller at 7:33 a.m. blocking the stair with the serial facing the NO STORAGE IN EGRESS sign. Neighbor Eden said babies were exceptions. I was forty-two, tenant, holding the fire-code PDF. I reported the serial and the sign together. Management tagged the stroller and cited the sign Eden had voted for. The stair at 7:33 looks like a stair, which is to say steps and nobody's wheels. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.video_title: The stroller sat under the no-storage sign they voted for — Part 1/1
social.description: Egress blocked, a serial on camera, a fire-code PDF. Has a hallway ever stored a vote?
